reason: The current goal calls for fitting the spindle to the base.
expectation: The spindle will fit into the base's central hole.

effect: The spindle is mounted, and the next goal is to fit the motor.
reaction: The central pulley and support are now in place.
reason: The current goal calls for fitting the motor to the base.
expectation: The motor will mount on the base beside the spindle.

effect: The motor is mounted beside the spindle, ready for the belt.
reaction: The two pulleys make the next connection clear.
reason: The goal calls for looping the belt around the mounted pulleys.
expectation: The belt will connect the motor pulley to the spindle pulley.

effect: The belt now connects the two pulleys; the drive is ready for its guard.
reaction: The belt makes the drive connection clear.
reason: The goal calls for placing the guard over the drive on the base.
expectation: The guard will cover the belt and pulleys.

effect: The guard covers the drive, and the next goal is to plug in the battery.
reaction: The translucent cover still lets the mechanism show through.
reason: The battery and dial is the available power unit for the motor.
expectation: The battery unit will connect to the motor on the base.

effect: The battery and control box are fitted; the deck is the remaining visible part for the current goal.
reaction: The control box sits outside the guarded drive, as expected.
reason: The goal calls for fitting the deck onto the spindle mounted in the base.
expectation: The deck will sit on the spindle above the covered drive.

effect: The deck completed the carousel, with the guarded drive below it and the control box at the front.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the drive assembly become a complete turning deck.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the belt between the two pulleys made the motor-to-spindle drive especially clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Plugging in the battery was less clear in the text: the result showed the control box outside the guard, but not the connection itself.

surprise.text: The translucent guard left the mechanism's outlines visible rather than hiding them completely.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each followed a clear construction goal.

continue.text: I would continue for another construction, because the explicit goals and visible changes made the mechanism easy to follow, though I cannot judge the pictures or hands-on experience from text.
